scope: Source-linked mathematical analysis and same-team review; no novelty, formal proof, unconditional improved ECDLP complexity, or empirical speed claim.
statement: A norm-one Dickson selector instantiates the compositional factor-base interface of prime-field PKM/Semaev index calculus. The report derives the regular Prime31 zero fibre and a binary line FFT on its full quotient, distinguishes direct group transfer and auxiliary-input algorithms, and identifies retained elliptic relation extraction as an unresolved cost dependency.
